verdict.paragraph: Unifortes scores 63 out of 100, a visible gap from a strong result but closer than most manufacturers at this stage. On the benchmark that matters most, Numafa, the credibility tie is even right now. Small, specific gains tip it in Unifortes' favour. Trade show and print materials are already a genuine strength. The clearest place to close the gap is the website, where speed, design age, and a disruptive popup are holding back an otherwise solid brand.

firstFix.why: The website is where most buyers form their first and often only impression before contacting a supplier. A slow mobile load, an aging design, and a popup that covers the hero all create friction at the exact moment a buyer is deciding whether to read further or leave. Fixing these three things costs nothing in new content and immediately changes how the whole brand reads.
firstFix.inPractice: Start by removing the brochure popup on first load and placing the brochure download as a visible button in the navigation or hero instead. Next, run image compression and defer non-critical scripts to bring mobile PageSpeed above 70. Finally, refresh the hero section typography and spacing to a cleaner, more current layout without changing the brand colours or logo. These are contained changes that do not require a full redesign.
